oidcFederationEntityId.documentation: OpenID Federation entity identifier (defaults to issuer URL)

oidcFederationAuthorityHints.documentation: OpenID Federation authority hints (space-separated entity IDs)

oidcFederationSigningKey.documentation: Key ID used for signing federation entity statements

oidcFederationSigningAlg.documentation: Algorithm for signing federation entity statements

oidcFederationTrustAnchors.documentation: OpenID Federation trust anchors (entity ID => JWKS JSON)

oidcFederationFetchTimeout.documentation: Timeout in seconds for one federation HTTP fetch

oidcFederationResolutionTimeout.documentation: Maximum wall-clock time in seconds for one trust chain resolution (0 uses the default)

oidcFederationAllowPrivateHosts.documentation: Allow loopback/private/link-local hosts and use the standard LWP agent (proxy support, per-read timeout). Lab use only

oidcFederationCacheTTL.documentation: Seconds to cache trust chain resolutions, including negative results (0 disables)

oidcRPMetaDataOptionsFederationEntityId.documentation: OpenID Federation entity identifier for this RP
